en: A sepia-toned interior view of a richly decorated Gothic room with vaulted ceiling, ornate stone doorway topped by coats of arms, a sculptural niche, wooden paneling, tables and chairs. The scene appears to be a historical municipal office or council room. Printed German text at the bottom identifies it as a room in the Breslau town hall, specifically the antechamber of the senior mayor and mayor.
